pages.markdown: # CD50 / ICAM-3 Antibody, Mouse MAb Catalog Number: 10333-MM02 Flow cytometric analysis of human ICAM3(CD50) expression on human peripheral blood lymphocytes. Cells were stained with purified anti-Human ICAM3(CD50), then a FITC-conjugated second step antibody. The histogram were derived from events with the forward and side light-scatter characteristics of viable lymphocytes. Flow cytometry was performed on a BD FACSCalibur flow cytometry system. Please refer to www.sinobiological.com/Flow- Cytometry-FACS-Protocols-a-750.html for technical protocols. Manufactured By Sino Biological Inc., FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. NOT FOR USE IN HUMANS. Tel: 215-583-7898 (US); +86-400-890-9989(Global) . http://www.sinobiological.com

The logo for Sino Biological features a circular icon containing the letters 'SB' in white, with a blue sphere element. To the right of the icon is the text 'Sino Biological' in a bold, dark font, with the tagline 'Biological Solution Specialist' in a smaller, lighter font below it.


Catalog Number: 10333-MM02


Relative Cell Number

10° 10 10ª 10 104 Purified ICAM3(CD50), with isotype control (FITC second step)
This is a flow cytometry histogram comparing two series: a gray dashed line representing the isotype control and a solid black line representing Purified ICAM3(CD50). The X-axis is labeled 'Purified ICAM3(CD50), with isotype control (FITC second step)' on a logarithmic scale from 10^0 to 10^4, and the Y-axis is labeled 'Relative Cell Number'. The chart shows a clear rightward shift of the black curve compared to the gray control curve, indicating positive expression of ICAM3(CD50).


Flow cytometric analysis of human ICAM3(CD50) expression on human peripheral blood lymphocytes. Cells were stained with purified anti-Human ICAM3(CD50), then a FITC-conjugated second step antibody. The histogram were derived from events with the forward and side light-scatter characteristics of viable lymphocytes.

Flow cytometry was performed on a BD FACSCalibur flow cytometry system. Please refer to www.sinobiological.com/Flow- Cytometry-FACS-Protocols-a-750.html for technical protocols.
